column1: # Elements USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2024 tracks as commodities with
# country-level production tables. An element in this list with no row in
# usgs.tsv is NOT PRODUCED in Indonesia — a different fact from producing a
# small amount, and given a different appearance (invariant 9).
# An element absent from this list has no USGS production data at all and is
# rendered as unknown, never as zero.
